entries.proposition: NOT WWOX EVIDENCE (substitute, disease class). The report title says biotinidase deficiency is 'a rare and treatable cause for generalized epilepsy', but the patient's seizure freedom is on levetiracetam plus biotin and the authors write that the relationship to her epilepsy is unknown.
entries.snippet: No further seizure episodes were observed, although the relationship to her epilepsy is unknown.
